model.name: iosSafari.realTestPath
model.description: Run our gates against actual iOS Safari (version-specific) via a physical device or a cloud device service; until then, iOS-specific ACs are code-proof + signature-match only and are labeled so (never device-verified-by-us), enforced by the no-false-iOS-green guard.
model.note: Acquisition = infra (PO/fleet: device or cloud device service). The enforceable guards (no-ios-coverage-claim-via-playwright-webkit + ios-ac-not-claim-device-verified-without-path) are lints the architect/expert can wire now. Tester gates them.
